spanish: Y tomó Balaq a Bilam a cabeza del Peor, el que mira sobre faces del Yesimón.

findings.issue: Definite common noun (Ncmsa) is Hebraized and capitalized as the proper name Yesimón; the token licenses a Spanish common noun.
“a” before “cabeza” supplies a preposition; ראש is a construct noun with no preposition token.
Niphal masculine singular participle with the article is smoothed to the finite verb mira.

notes: Balaq, Bilam, and Peor match the proper-noun tokens; faces keeps the plural construct; tomó keeps qal 3ms.
